KBLab/kb-whisper-large.reason: KBLab's KB-Whisper Large, the National Library of Sweden's Swedish ASR model fine-tuned from OpenAI Whisper large-v3 (per its Hugging Face card); a fine-tune is not openai/whisper-large-v3 itself and the index has no KB-Whisper entry.

Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-4B.reason: Alibaba's Qwen3-Reranker-4B (Hugging Face Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-4B, Jun 2025), the mid-size text reranker of the Qwen3 Embedding/Reranker series; the index has only the 0.6B and 8B rerankers, so defer rather than link a different size.

intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct.reason: Exact id: the multilingual-e5-large-instruct embedding model (Hugging Face, MIT license, Feb 2024, 512-token window); evroc's 0.114/1M hosted rate is a premium over the model's 0.01 median.
